Xi, Putin, and Trump Hold Unprecedented Three-Way Talks

Leaders Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and Donald Trump participated in an unprecedented three-way meeting. The summit, which took place in Shenzhen, highlighted a shared hostility towards the liberal international order. However, the question of who will establish the rules for the post-liberal order remains unresolved. One analysis suggested that while Putin and Xi 'got the goods,' Trump received only a 'fig leaf' to mask his embarrassment. The absence of the European Union from the discussions was noted.
